initial_application: The issue was applied as svn r10151, preserved in git commit dbe68561c0544b311214cd486e6ccc2ba8668e93, which changed the old ConceptMap.source[x] and ConceptMap.target[x] spreadsheet cardinalities from 1..1 to 0..1 and added no-specified-context comment text.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. Later work renamed ConceptMap.source[x] and ConceptMap.target[x] to sourceScope[x] and targetScope[x] while preserving 0..1 cardinalities. The active ConceptMap operation list now contains only $translate because later R6-prep work removed $closure. Related FHIR-14710 later reconsidered mandatory ConceptMap source/target cardinalities and explicitly preserved the FHIR-12314 optionality.
